theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_blowUp_isBoundaryOfRegion
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN → IsBoundaryOfRegion (blowUp T y lam hlam.ne') (dilation y lam '' E) (fun w => ξN (y + lam • w))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
